title: ‘The Odyssey’ Cast Guide: All the Heroes, Gods and Characters in Christopher Nolan’s Greek Epic
content:
Christopher Nolan’s adaptation of Homer’s Greek epic “The Odyssey” is, well, epic.

Releasing in theaters July 17, Nolan’s latest film reimagines the famous Greek tale of Odysseus, starring Matt Damon as the king of Ithaca.

After teaching the Trojans that maybe youshouldlook a giant, wooden gift horse in the mouth, Odysseus and his soldiers must embark on a long, treacherous journey (i.e., an odyssey) to get back home. The harrowing trip back to Ithaca is fraught with storms, monsters and plenty of twists as Odysseus is plagued by memories of the Trojan War and visions of the goddess Athena (played by Zendaya).

Meanwhile back in Ithaca, Anne Hathaway plays Odysseus’ wife Penelope, who’s trying to keep the peace in her home and must fend off a horde of would-be suitors with the help of her son Telemachus, played by Tom Holland.

The supporting cast is a who’s who of Hollywood stars, including several of Nolan’s past collaborators like Robert Pattinson, Elliot Page, Benny Safdie and Himesh Patel, plus Jon Bernthal, Charlize Theron, John Leguizamo, Lupita Nyong’o and more.

Here is a breakdown of the key characters and the actors who play gods, monsters and men:

Matt Damon (“Good Will Hunting,” “The Martian”) stars as the eponymous Odysseus. Homer’s epic follows the aftermath of the Trojan war as Odysseus and his men attempt to return home to Ithaca. Along the way, he encounters a full cast of Greek gods and monsters, including goddess of wisdom and war Athena (Zendaya), the sorceress Circe (Samantha Morton), sea nymph Calypso (Charlize Theron) and cyclops Polyphemus (Bill Irwin). This is Damon’s third collaboration with Christopher Nolan, after “Interstellar” and “Oppenheimer,” but his first as the central character.

Tom Holland is Telemachus, the son Odysseus barely knew before leaving for Troy. Now almost of age, Telemachus is conflicted: Does he believe his mother Penelope that his father, who he so desperately wants to know, is still alive and coming home to claim his throne? Or, does he listen to the travelers who have heard no news of Odysseus and attempt to ascend to the throne of Ithaca himself to protect his mother from the scoundrel suitors? Holland also stars alongside fellow “The Odyssey” cast members Zendaya (Athena) and Jon Bernthal (Menelaus) in “Spider-Man: Brand New Day,” which hits theaters July 31.

The steadfast queen of Ithaca is played by Anne Hathaway. As she waits for Odysseus to return from Troy, she fends off the increasingly rabid suitors invoking Zeus’ law of hospitality to gorge themselves on the palace’s food and wine and force her to choose one of them as her husband. Hathaway’s film credits include “The Devil Wears Prada” and previous Nolan collaborations “The Dark Knight Rises” and “Interstellar.”

Robert Pattinson is the conniving suitor Antinous, who plots for control of Ithaca in Odysseus’s absence. He has an affair with Melantho, mocks Eumaeus, threatens Telemachus and generally debauches the palace in his attempt to win Penelope’s hand. Pattinson’s other film credits include “The Batman,” “The Drama” and Nolan’s “Tenet.”

Zendaya stars as the goddess of wisdom Athena. Also the goddess of strategic warfare, Athena opposes the lawless actions the soldiers exhibited during the Battle of Troy and frequently visits Odysseus on his journey home to remind him of the cruelty, which goes against Zeus’ law. The actress got her start on Disney Channel and quickly rose to fame in HBO’s “Euphoria,” which earned her two Emmys and a third nomination for the upcoming award show. She is currently starring in the “Spider-Man” and “Dune” franchises, both of which have new films premiering this year. Her additional credits include “The Drama” (alongside co-star Robert Pattinson), “Challengers” and “The Greatest Showman.”

Benny Safdie returns to collaborate with Christopher Nolan after previously starring in “Oppenheimer.” The actor and filmmaker plays Agamemnon, the king of Mycenae who led the Greeks to victory in the Trojan War. While he believed he’d be welcomed home as a hero, his wife, Clytemnestra, had other plans (and a desire for vengeance) in store. Safdie previously directed “Daddy Longlengs” and “Uncut Gems” with his brother, and he was also featured in Paul Thomas Anderson’s “Licorice Pizza.”

The king of Sparta is played by Jon Bernthal. Menelaus is the brother of Agamemnon and husband of Helen of Troy, whose beauty and abduction started the Trojan War. The king fought alongside Odysseus and tells Telemachus old stories of them in battle while celebrating his daughter’s wedding alongside his wife. Bernthal previously starred in “The Punisher” and will appear in “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” alongside co-stars Tom Holland and Zendaya.

Lupita Nyong’o pulls double duty in Nolan’s epic adaptation. As Helen of Troy, wife of King Menelaus of Sparta (Jon Bernthal), she takes up the mantle of “the face that launched 1,000 ships.” Translations of the Greek epic differ on if she was kidnapped by or eloped with Prince Paris of Troy, but her departure kickstarted the decade-long conflict between the Greeks and Trojans. And as Clytemnestra, Nyong’o is Helen’s sister and wife of Agamemnon, the king of Mycenae who commanded the Greek army during the Trojan War. Translations again differ on the level of her involvement, but Clytemnestra plays a role in her husband’s fate after his triumphant return. Nyong’o is an Academy Award-winner for her role in “12 Years a Slave.” Her other credits include “Black Panther” and “Us,” where she also plays a dual role.

Elliot Page reunites with Nolan after starring in “Inception” back in 2010 alongside Cillian Murphy and Joseph Gordon-Levitt. Page portrays Sinon, a Greek soldier who plays a crucial role in the Trojan horse plan and helping mislead the Trojans; Sinon is not mentioned in Homer’s original text but his story is told in Virgil’s poem “Aeneid.” Page had his breakout role in the coming-of-age comedy “Juno,” which earned him an Oscar nomination back in 2008.

Odysseus’ journey wouldn’t be complete without his second-in-command Eurylochus, who frequently challenges him about his treatment of the army. Patel led Danny Boyle’s 2019 musical drama “Yesterday” alongside Lily James and appeared in Nolan’s thriller “Tenet,” in addition to “Don’t Look Up,” “Station Eleven,” “Enola Holmes 2,” “Black Mirror,” “The Franchise” and “Bait.” Next up, he will lead Oscar-winner Ryan Coogler’s highly anticipated “X-Files” reboot for Hulu.

John Leguizamo plays Eumaeus, a nearly blind swineherd who’s fiercely loyal to Odysseus, even when everybody believed the hero wouldn’t return. When Odysseus ultimately arrived home after decades away, Eumaeus was the first person he sought. Leguizamo previously starred in “Encanto” and “Moulin Rouge!,” and he also voiced Sid the Sloth in the “Ice Age” franchise.

Bil lrwin plays Polyphemus, the one-eyed cyclops and son of Poseidon who is blinded by Odysseus and his men in their attempt to escape the giant’s cave. Irwin previously worked with Nolan on “Interstellar,” where he voiced and operated the robot TARS. His additional credits include “Rachel Getting Married” and Jim Carrey’s “How the Grinch Stole Christmas.”

Samantha Morton plays Circe, the Greek goddess with the power to transform humans into animals — not that Odysseus’ men know all the details when they turn up at her cottage on the island of Aeaea, desperate for food. In Homer’s classic novel, she turns Odysseus’ men into pigs. Morton is an Oscar-nominated actor for her work in “Sweet and Lowdown” and “In America,” both which released in the early 2000s. She also scored an Emmy nod for the TV movie “Longford” directed by Tom Hooper. Additional credits include “Morvern Callar,” “Minority Report,” “Synecdoche, New York,” “She Said,” “The Whale” and “Anemone.”

Charlize Theron (“The Devil’s Advocate,” “Mad Max Fury Road”) plays Calypso, a sea nymph who tricks Odysseus into staying on her island for years. Although initially acting out of a desire to heal the hero phsyically, Calypso becomes infatuated with Odysseus and delays his departure for as long as she can. Theron earned an Academy Award, Golden Globe and SAG Award for her role in “Monster” and also starred in “North Country” and “Young Adult.”

“Straight Outta Compton” and Crime 101″ star Corey Hawkins plays Polybus, one of Penelope’s suitors who works closely alongside the conniving Antinous. Hawkins earned an Emmy nod for his work in the limited series “Survive,” which released in 2020. Additional credits include “Iron Man 3,” “Kong: Skull Island,” “The Tragedy of Macbeth,” “The Color Purple” and “In the Heights.”

The horror scream queen known for “Pearl” and “X” makes a brief but memorable appearance as Melantho, one of Queen Penelope’s slaves who sleeps with her suitors. In the film, she deceives Penelope by working with the power-hungry Antinous, who wishes to wed Penelope and become the new king of Ithaca. Outside of her work with Ti West, Goth’s horror credits include “Frankenstein,” “Infinity Pool” and “A Cure for Wellness,” and next year she will appear in Shawn Levy’s “Star Wars: Starfighter” movie alongside Ryan Gosling.

Logan Marshall-Green appears as Melanthius, a slave and servant of Queen Penelope who mocks Odysseus when he returns to Ithaca in disguise. Marshall-Green starred in Leigh Whannell’s 2018 thriller “Upgrade.” TV credits include “Law & Order,” “24,” “The O.C.,” “When They See Us” and, most recently, “Marshals.”

It only makes sense that “The Odyssey,” an epic poem (in both senses of the word) opens with a bard—an ancient Greek poet and storyteller—telling the tale of Odysseus. Travis Scott makes his acting debut as the bard in Nolan’s adaptation and is the first figure and voice on screen. Nolan, who previously collaborated with Scott on music for “Tenet” (2020), credited this casting as a way to link the tradition of oral storytelling with the lyricism of modern rap. Scott also closes the film on the end credits track, “When I’m Home,” which he co-wrote.

After playing U.S. Secretary of War Henry Stimson in the Oscar-winning “Oppenheimer,” James Remar reunites with Nolan just two years later for “The Odyssey.” He plays Tiresias, the blind prophet whom Odysseus visits in hell, ultimately guiding him back to Ithaca to reunite with his son. Remar’s nearly 200 credits date back to the ’70s, with roles in “The Warriors,” “Drugstore Cowboy,” “Fatal Instinct,” “Mortal Kombat: Annihilation,” “Sex and the City,” “Criminal Minds,” “X-Men: First Class,” “Once Upon a Time in Hollywood,” “Megalopolis” and “It: Welcome to Derry.”
title_zh: 《奧德賽(The Odyssey)》角色指南：克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)的希臘史詩中的所有英雄、神祇和角色
content_zh:
克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)改編的荷馬希臘史詩《奧德賽》(The Odyssey)可謂史詩般的作品。

該片將於7月17日上映，諾蘭最新的電影重新詮釋了著名的希臘故事，馬特·達蒙(Matt Damon)飾演伊薩卡的國王奧德修斯。

在教導特洛伊人要小心那個巨大的木馬之後，奧德修斯和他的士兵必須展開一段漫長而危險的旅程（即奧德賽）以回到家鄉。返回伊薩卡的艱難旅程充滿了風暴、怪物和許多曲折，奧德修斯被特洛伊戰爭的回憶和女神雅典娜(由辛迪亞·鄧恩(Zendaya)飾演)的幻影所困擾。

同時，在伊薩卡，安·海瑟薇(Anne Hathaway)飾演奧德修斯的妻子佩內洛普，她努力維持家庭的和諧，並在兒子泰勒馬克斯(由湯姆·霍蘭德(Tom Holland)飾演)的幫助下抵禦一群想要求婚的追求者。

配角陣容則是好萊塢明星的盛會，包括諾蘭過去的幾位合作夥伴，如羅伯特·帕丁森(Robert Pattinson)、艾略特·佩吉(Elliot Page)、班尼·薩夫迪(Benny Safdie)和海梅什·帕特爾(Himesh Patel)，以及喬恩·伯恩薩爾(Jon Bernthal)、查理茲·塞隆(Charlize Theron)、約翰·萊古茲亞莫(John Leguizamo)、露皮塔·尼永奧(Lupita Nyong’o)等。

以下是主要角色及其扮演者的介紹：

馬特·達蒙(Matt Damon)在片中飾演同名角色奧德修斯。荷馬的史詩講述了特洛伊戰爭後，奧德修斯和他的手下試圖返回伊薩卡的故事。在這段旅程中，他遇到了各種希臘神祇和怪物，包括智慧與戰爭之女神雅典娜(辛迪亞·鄧恩(Zendaya))、女巫基爾克(薩曼莎·莫頓(Samantha Morton))、海妖卡莉普索(查理茲·塞隆(Charlize Theron))和獨眼巨人波里費摩斯(比爾·厄文(Bill Irwin))。這是達蒙與克里斯多福·諾蘭的第三次合作，之前的作品有《星際穿越》(Interstellar)和《奧本海默》(Oppenheimer)，但這是他首次擔任主角。

湯姆·霍蘭德(Tom Holland)飾演泰勒馬克斯，奧德修斯在出征特洛伊前幾乎不認識的兒子。如今，泰勒馬克斯已近成年，內心矛盾：他是否相信母親佩內洛普的話，認為他那渴望認識的父親仍然活著並將回來奪回王位？還是他聽信那些沒有奧德修斯消息的旅人，試圖自己登上伊薩卡的王位，以保護母親免受那些無賴求婚者的侵擾？霍蘭德還與《奧德賽》的其他演員辛迪亞·鄧恩(雅典娜)和喬恩·伯恩薩爾(梅內勞斯)共同出演《蜘蛛人：全新的一天》(Spider-Man: Brand New Day)，該片將於7月31日上映。

伊薩卡的堅定女王由安·海瑟薇(Anne Hathaway)飾演。她在等待奧德修斯從特洛伊歸來的同時，抵擋著越來越瘋狂的求婚者，這些人利用宙斯的款待法則，肆意享用宮殿的食物和美酒，迫使她選擇其中一人作為丈夫。海瑟薇的電影作品包括《穿著普拉達的惡魔》(The Devil Wears Prada)以及之前與諾蘭合作的《黑暗騎士崛起》(The Dark Knight Rises)和《星際穿越》(Interstellar)。

羅伯特·帕丁森(Robert Pattinson)飾演狡詐的求婚者安提諾斯(Antinous)，他在奧德修斯(Odysseus)缺席期間策劃控制伊薩卡(Ithaca)。他與梅蘭托(Melantho)有染，嘲諷尤瑪俄斯(Eumaeus)，威脅特勒馬科斯(Telemachus)，並在試圖贏得佩內洛普(Penelope)的手時，肆意敗壞宮殿。帕丁森的其他電影作品包括《蝙蝠俠》(The Batman)、《戲劇》(The Drama)和諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)的《信條》(Tenet)。

辛迪亞(Zendaya)飾演智慧女神雅典娜(Athena)。作為戰略戰爭的女神，雅典娜反對士兵們在特洛伊戰役中表現出的無法無天行為，並經常在奧德修斯的回家旅程中造訪他，提醒他殘酷的行為違背了宙斯(Zeus)的法律。這位女演員起初在迪士尼頻道出道，並迅速因HBO的《亢奮》(Euphoria)而成名，該劇為她贏得了兩個艾美獎和即將到來的頒獎典禮的第三次提名。她目前在《蜘蛛人》(Spider-Man)和《沙丘》(Dune)系列中主演，這兩部作品都將於今年首映。她的其他作品包括與羅伯特·帕丁森共同主演的《戲劇》(The Drama)、《挑戰者》(Challengers)和《大娛樂家》(The Greatest Showman)。

班尼·薩夫迪(Benny Safdie)回歸與克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)合作，此前他曾在《奧本海默》(Oppenheimer)中主演。這位演員和導演飾演阿伽門農(Agamemnon)，他是邁錫尼(Mycenae)的國王，曾帶領希臘人贏得特洛伊戰爭的勝利。雖然他相信自己會被當作英雄歡迎回家，但他的妻子克萊泰梅斯特拉(Clytemnestra)卻有其他計劃（以及復仇的慾望）。薩夫迪之前與他的兄弟共同執導了《長腿爸爸》(Daddy Longlegs)和《未剪輯的寶石》(Uncut Gems)，他也曾出現在保羅·托馬斯·安德森(Paul Thomas Anderson)的《甘草披薩》(Licorice Pizza)中。

斯巴達國王由喬恩·伯恩薩爾(Jon Bernthal)飾演。梅內拉俄斯(Menelaus)是阿伽門農的兄弟，也是特洛伊美女海倫(Helen of Troy)的丈夫，她的美貌和被綁架事件引發了特洛伊戰爭。這位國王與奧德修斯並肩作戰，並在與妻子慶祝女兒的婚禮時，向特勒馬科斯講述他們在戰鬥中的往事。伯恩薩爾之前主演過《惩罚者》(The Punisher)，並將與湯姆·霍蘭德(Tom Holland)和辛迪亞共同出演《蜘蛛人：全新的一天》(Spider-Man: Brand New Day)。

露皮塔·尼永奧(Lupita Nyong’o)在諾蘭的史詩改編中擔任雙重角色。作為特洛伊的海倫，斯巴達國王梅內拉俄斯的妻子，她承擔了“引發千艘船出航的面孔”的角色。希臘史詩的翻譯對於她是被特洛伊王子帕里斯(Paris)綁架還是私奔存在不同的說法，但她的離去引發了希臘人和特洛伊人之間長達十年的衝突。而作為克萊泰梅斯特拉，尼永奧是海倫的姐妹，也是阿伽門農的妻子，阿伽門農是特洛伊戰爭期間指揮希臘軍隊的邁錫尼國王。翻譯對於她的參與程度再次存在差異，但克萊泰梅斯特拉在她丈夫的命運中扮演了重要角色，尤其是在他凱旋歸來之後。尼永奧因在《為奴十二年》(12 Years a Slave)中的表現獲得奧斯卡獎。她的其他作品包括《黑豹》(Black Panther)和《我們》(Us)，在其中她也飾演雙重角色。

艾略特·佩奇(Elliot Page)在2010年與基利安·墨菲(Cillian Murphy)和約瑟夫·高登-萊維特(Joseph Gordon-Levitt)共同主演的《全面啟動(Inception)》後，與克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)再次合作。佩奇在片中飾演西農(Sinon)，一名希臘士兵，在特洛伊木馬計劃中扮演關鍵角色，並幫助誤導特洛伊人；西農在荷馬的原著中並未被提及，但他的故事在維吉爾的詩作《埃涅阿斯紀(Aeneid)》中有所描述。佩奇在成長喜劇《朱諾(Juno)》中獲得突破性角色，並因此在2008年獲得奧斯卡提名。

奧德修斯(Odysseus)的旅程若沒有他的副手尤利洛克斯(Eurylochus)將不會完整，尤利洛克斯經常質疑奧德修斯對軍隊的對待。帕特爾(Patel)曾與丹尼·博伊爾(Danny Boyle)合作，主演2019年的音樂劇《昨日(Yesterday)》，並在諾蘭的驚悚片《信條(Tenet)》中出現，此外還參與了《別眨眼(Don’t Look Up)》、《第十一站(Station Eleven)》、《艾諾拉·霍姆斯2(Enola Holmes 2)》、《黑鏡(Black Mirror)》、《特許經營(The Franchise)》和《誘餌(Bait)》。接下來，他將主演奧斯卡獲獎者瑞安·庫格勒(Ryan Coogler)備受期待的Hulu《X檔案(X-Files)》重啟版。

約翰·萊吉扎莫(John Leguizamo)飾演尤美厄斯(Eumaeus)，一位幾乎失明的豬倌，對奧德修斯忠心耿耿，即使在所有人都認為這位英雄不會回來的時候。當奧德修斯在離家數十年後終於回到家中，尤美厄斯是他尋找的第一個人。萊吉扎莫曾主演《魔法滿屋(Encanto)》和《紅磨坊(Moulin Rouge!)》，並在《冰河世紀(Ice Age)》系列中為樹懶西德(Sid the Sloth)配音。

比爾·厄文(Bill Irwin)飾演獨眼巨人波里斐摩斯(Polyphemus)，他是波塞冬(Poseidon)的兒子，奧德修斯和他的手下試圖逃離巨人的洞穴時使他失明。厄文之前曾與諾蘭合作於《星際穿越(Interstellar)》，在片中為機器人TARS配音並操作。其他作品包括《瑞秋要結婚(Rachel Getting Married)》和金·凱瑞(Jim Carrey)的《聖誕怪傑(How the Grinch Stole Christmas)》。

薩曼莎·莫頓(Samantha Morton)飾演希爾西(Circe)，這位希臘女神擁有將人類變成動物的能力——當奧德修斯的手下在艾艾亞島(Aeaea)的她的小屋出現時，他們對所有細節並不知情，當時他們急需食物。在荷馬的經典小說中，她將奧德修斯的手下變成豬。莫頓因在《甜蜜與低調(Sweet and Lowdown)》和《在美國(In America)》中的表現而獲得奧斯卡提名，這兩部作品均於2000年代初上映。她還因湯姆·霍珀(Tom Hooper)執導的電視電影《朗福德(Longford)》獲得艾美獎提名。其他作品包括《摩爾文·卡拉(Morvern Callar)》、《少數派報告(Minority Report)》、《紐約的代名詞(Synecdoche, New York)》、《她說(She Said)》、《鯨魚(The Whale)》和《海葵(Anemone)》。

查理茲·塞隆(Charlize Theron)（《魔鬼代言人(The Devil’s Advocate)》、《瘋狂麥斯：憤怒道(Mad Max Fury Road)》）飾演卡莉普索(Calypso)，一位海妖，她欺騙奧德修斯在她的島上待了多年。雖然最初出於想要治癒這位英雄的身體，但卡莉普索漸漸愛上奧德修斯，並盡可能地延遲他的離開。塞隆因在《怪物(Monster)》中的角色獲得奧斯卡獎、金球獎和演員工會獎(SAG Award)，並曾主演《北國(North Country)》和《年輕的成年人(Young Adult)》。

《直擊康普頓(Straight Outta Compton)》和《犯罪101(Crime 101)》的明星科瑞·霍金斯(Corey Hawkins)在電影中飾演波利布斯(Polybus)，他是佩內洛普(Penelope)的追求者之一，與陰險的安提諾斯(Antinous)密切合作。霍金斯因在2020年推出的限量劇集《生存(Survive)》中的表現獲得艾美獎提名。其他作品包括《鋼鐵人3(Iron Man 3)》、《哥吉拉：骷髏島(Kong: Skull Island)》、《麥克白的悲劇(The Tragedy of Macbeth)》、《紫色姐妹花(The Color Purple)》和《高地(In the Heights)》。

以《珍珠(Pearl)》和《X》聞名的恐怖女王梅根·戈斯(Mia Goth)在電影中短暫但令人印象深刻地飾演梅蘭索(Melantho)，她是佩內洛普的奴隸之一，與她的追求者共度良宵。在影片中，她與渴望權力的安提諾斯合作，欺騙佩內洛普，安提諾斯希望娶佩內洛普並成為伊薩卡(Ithaca)的新國王。除了與提·韋斯(Ti West)的合作外，戈斯的恐怖作品還包括《科學怪人(Frankenstein)》、《無限池(Infinity Pool)》和《健康的療法(A Cure for Wellness)》，明年她將與瑞安·高斯林(Ryan Gosling)一同出現在肖恩·利維(Shawn Levy)的《星際大戰：星際戰鬥機(Star Wars: Starfighter)》電影中。

洛根·馬歇爾·格林(Logan Marshall-Green)在電影中飾演梅蘭提烏斯(Melanthius)，他是佩內洛普的奴隸和僕人，當奧德修斯(Odysseus)化妝回到伊薩卡時，他嘲笑奧德修斯。馬歇爾·格林曾在利·瓦納爾(Leigh Whannell)的2018年驚悚片《升級(Upgrade)》中主演。電視作品包括《法律與秩序(Law & Order)》、《24小時(24)》、《海灘救護隊(The O.C.)》、《當他們看見我們(When They See Us)》，以及最近的《執法者(Marshals)》。

《奧德賽(The Odyssey)》這首史詩詩篇（在兩個意義上）以一位吟遊詩人開場——一位古希臘詩人和故事講述者，講述奧德修斯的故事。特拉維斯·史考特(Travis Scott)在諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)的改編中首次亮相，擔任吟遊詩人，並成為螢幕上的第一個角色和聲音。諾蘭曾在2020年的《信條(Tenet)》中與史考特合作音樂，並將這次的選角視為將口述故事傳統與現代饒舌的歌詞主義聯繫起來的方式。史考特還在電影的片尾曲《當我回家(When I’m Home)》中閉幕，這首歌是他共同創作的。

在奧斯卡獲獎影片《奧本海默(Oppenheimer)》中飾演美國戰爭部長亨利·斯廷森(Henry Stimson)的詹姆斯·瑞瑪(James Remar)在兩年後再次與諾蘭合作《奧德賽》。他在片中飾演提瑞西阿斯(Tiresias)，這位盲目的預言家是奧德修斯在地獄中拜訪的角色，最終引導他回到伊薩卡與他的兒子團聚。瑞瑪的作品幾乎有200部，追溯至70年代，包括《戰士們(The Warriors)》、《毒品商人(Drugstore Cowboy)》、《致命本能(Fatal Instinct)》、《真人快打：毀滅(Mortal Kombat: Annihilation)》、《欲望城市(Sex and the City)》、《犯罪心理(Criminal Minds)》、《X戰警：第一戰(X-Men: First Class)》、《好萊塢往事(Once Upon a Time in Hollywood)》、《大都會(Megalopolis)》和《小丑回魂(It: Welcome to Derry)》。
summary_zh:
克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)改編的荷馬希臘史詩《奧德賽》(The Odyssey)可謂史詩般的作品。

該片將於7月17日上映，諾蘭最新的電影重新詮釋了著名的希臘故事，馬特·達蒙(Matt Damon)飾演伊薩卡的國王奧德修斯。

在教導特洛伊人要小心那個巨大的木馬之後，奧德修斯和他的士兵必須展開一段漫長而危險的旅程（即奧德賽）以回到家鄉。
